description: Source code for a class that generates Visual Studio project and solution files, including functions for writing project configurations, filters, and handling target filtering and path management within a build system.

classes.name: SolutionEntry
classes.description: Represents a solution folder or project with name, path, guid, and optional parent folder.

classes.name: SolutionProject
classes.description: Represents a Visual Studio project with additional path and configuration platform info.

classes.name: SourceFileCompileTypePair
classes.description: Associates a source file with its compile type in the project.

classes.name: VisualStudioWriter
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating Visual Studio solution and project files, managing projects, folders, and target filtering.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFiles
methods.description: Static method to generate and write Visual Studio solution and project files based on build targets.

methods.name: WriteProjectFiles
methods.description: Generates project files for a specific build target.

methods.name: WriteProjectFileContents
methods.description: Writes the XML content of a project file.

methods.name: WriteFiltersFileContents
methods.description: Writes the XML content for source file filters.

methods.name: WriteSolutionFileContents
methods.description: Writes the content of the solution file.

methods.name: ResolveSolutionFolders
methods.description: Determines folder hierarchy for projects in the solution.

methods.name: GetNinjaTarget
methods.description: Returns the ninja build target name and whether it is a phony target.
